decisions.reason: The DPA management tool sits close to the core offer, supports the firm's stated compliance direction, and drew positive agency feedback, so it meets the aspiration and needs no problemistic search.
The management platform is featured on the home page and is central to the agency-focused strategy, so it performs at or above aspiration and anchors the firm's growth.
The configurable managed plan extends the core hosting business at low marginal cost, and slack from a growing industry lets the firm carry it while results remain uncertain.
